rows.behavior: kmctl verify decisions, in a repository with three decision records, a decisions index and a log, writes one verified entry and one log line per record and exits 0
rows.fails_when: the exit code is nonzero, a record lacks the entry, a log line is missing, or the decisions index changes by one byte

rows.behavior: a docs folder id (docs/how-to) verifies every docs page under it and leaves its README.md index alone
rows.fails_when: a page under the folder lacks the entry, a page outside it gains one, or the README.md changes

rows.behavior: a repository-root path with .md (.okf/decisions/0001-x.md, docs/how-to/x.md) verifies the same file its id would, and prints the id as kmctl review due does
rows.fails_when: either path is refused, or the printed id differs from the one review due lists

rows.behavior: an id for a file kmctl review due never lists (decisions/index, .okf/decisions/index.md, log) or the handoffs folder is refused, exits 1 and writes nothing
rows.fails_when: any of them exits 0, or any file in the repository changes

rows.behavior: a refusal for decisions/* and for decisions/index names the command kmctl verify decisions
rows.fails_when: the refusal on stderr does not contain 'kmctl verify decisions'

rows.behavior: kmctl verify --help names the folder form and the path form in its argument help and gives a folder example in its epilog, and the help tests stay green
rows.fails_when: the help lacks a folder id or a path with .md, or a test in test_help.py fails

rows.behavior: a draft decision record states the folder form and why it does not undo ADR 0055's rejection, and ADR 0055 has a correction pointing at it
rows.fails_when: the record is missing, is not linked from the decisions index, or ADR 0055 has no correction naming it
